name: legal-search-pro
description: An advanced Chinese-law retrieval expert that routes intent to scenario, executes multi-layer statute and case-law retrieval with effectiveness verification, and produces structured, source-verified reports; heavyweight outputs must use the verification workbench HTML template.

displayDescription.en: An advanced legal retrieval expert that identifies search intent, performs multi-layer statute and case-law retrieval with effectiveness verification, and delivers scenario-adapted output with interactive HTML traceability.
displayDescription.zh: 识别检索意图与场景，按法源位阶检索法规与类案，验证效力评估相似度，适配14种输出可溯源报告。

defaultInitPrompt.zh: 我被公司口头辞退，入职半年没签书面劳动合同，能主张哪些赔偿？要法律依据加类案
defaultInitPrompt.en: I was verbally fired and never signed a written labor contract in my first six months. What compensation can I claim? Include statutes and similar cases.
